internal.title: Kafka Consumer Lag Incident in Accounting Service - Resolved
internal.body:
At 10:42 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag in the accounting service, with a backlog of 5200 records. Diagnosis confirmed the backlog was due to processing delays and high latency in the accounting service. The ops team disabled the kafkaQueueProblems flag at 11:02 UTC, which resolved the backlog issue. Verification showed the consumer lag dropped from 5200 to 5 records, confirming recovery.

Timeline:
- 10:42:30 Alert received for KafkaConsumerLagHigh
- 11:02:13 Diagnosis identified queue backlog in accounting
- 11:02:19 Flag kafkaQueueProblems disabled
- 11:02:19 Recovery verified with lag reduced to normal levels

No further action is required at this time.
